simulation_design.error_unit: unique staging event keyed by individual_id, year, segment
simulation_design.shared_event_error: the same event error is reused when an event is destination of one transition and origin of the next
simulation_design.within_individual_year_error_process: stationary Gaussian AR1 across ordered staging events
simulation_design.point_estimator: exact OLS point slope for the frozen wigeon controller design; lambda_hat=1+beta_origin_phase
simulation_design.extrapolation: quadratic mean-lambda curve evaluated at zeta=-1

scenarios.name: equal_independent_replicates_rho0
scenarios.origin: SD(ERA5Land_phase-POWER_phase)/sqrt(2) from failed registered calibration run4

scenarios.name: equal_replicates_discrepancy_correlation_proxy
scenarios.origin: equal-replicate SD plus observed consecutive discrepancy correlation proxy

scenarios.name: conservative_full_disagreement_rho0
scenarios.origin: entire POWER-ERA5Land disagreement SD treated as event error

claim_boundary: SIMEX is a sensitivity analysis conditional on error scales from an incomplete registered calibration.
It does not convert the registered ERA5-Land calibration from FAIL to PASS.
It does not identify a gold-standard measurement-error distribution.
A SIMEX-extrapolated lambda is not promoted as the true latent biological lambda.
No scenario or extrapolation rule may be changed after SIMEX results are opened.
